notes: Boss fights: every 5 threat levels the land's boss arrives, and each is its own kind of fight (arena, fire-wall escape, cracking ice floe, diving Bog Mother, pylon-shielded Colossus, a hunt through the horde). Bosses glow so you can spot them. New weapons: Scattergun, Boomerang, Frost Nova (with evolutions). Heart Containers and new cards raise max HP; new Iron Skin and Guardian Orb pickups. Cards now show evolution recipes.
